# Authentic Barber & Beauty Salon

> Barber & beauty salon based in Del Valle, Texas. Cuts, fades and beard work on the barber side; color, extensions and lashes on the beauty side. Karina and Liz never rush and sweat every detail, en inglés o en español.

- Phone: (512) 590-5999
- Based in: Del Valle, TX
- Nearby areas: Del Valle, Austin, Garfield, Elroy, Mustang Ridge, Cedar Creek
- Google rating: 4.7 from 62 reviews

## Services
- Haircuts & fades: Regular cuts, tapers and clean fades. Show a photo of what you want and they bring it to life.
- Kids' cuts: A relaxed, family-friendly chair for the little ones, from curls to clean lineups.
- Beard & lineup: Beard trims, razor-sharp edges and a clean lineup to finish the cut, never rushed.
- Color & highlights: Color, highlights and soft blonde balayage, all the way to electric blue and custom designs. Reviewers rave about the color as much as the cuts.
- Hair extensions: Extensions blended in for length and volume.
- Lash extensions: Full, natural-looking eyelash extensions.

## About
Authentic Barber & Beauty Salon sits in Unit C at 4315 Caldwell Lane in Del Valle, just southeast of Austin. It is a barbershop and a beauty salon under one roof: fades and beard trims on one side, color, extensions and lashes on the other. Inside it feels like home: matte black walls, gold-framed mirrors, reclaimed wood, an ivy wall, a red-and-white barber pole and the World Cup on the TV. You might get your cut in a Lakers cape. The shop dresses up for the holidays and welcomes families and kids. Regulars keep coming back for Karina and Liz. Reviewers say they never rush, pay attention to every detail and keep prices reasonable, and the shop answers almost every review personally. In their words, good reviews "keep our chairs full and clippers buzzing," and regulars are treated like family. Tell them what you want, share a photo, and they will bring it to life. Se habla español.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 11 AM to 7 PM and Sunday 12 PM to 3 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 590-5999 if you are not sure.
- Q: What is the Tuesday special?
  A: Every Tuesday, regular haircuts are $25. That covers regular cuts with a guard 1 and up; fades are not included. Solo los martes.
- Q: Do you have a referral deal?
  A: Yes. Refer four friends and your fifth cut is free. Ask in the shop about the rewards for leaving a Google review too.
- Q: Do you do women's hair, color and lashes?
  A: Yes. Besides barber cuts and fades, the beauty side does women's cuts and styling, color and highlights, hair extensions and eyelash extensions.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. The shop is bilingual, so you can explain your cut in English or Spanish.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 4315 Caldwell Ln, Unit C, Del Valle, TX 78617, southeast of Austin near the airport.
